decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used and changes made to suspension while under Parc Ferme. 3rd Energy Store (ES) 3rd Control Electronics (CE) All Power Unit elements were replaced without the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate during Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article 40.9 c) and 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The changed PU elements were replaced whilst the car was in parc ferme without the approval of the Technical Delegate. Further changes were made to the suspension with the approval of the Technical Delegate. As such this setup is different from what was run in Qualifying. As the PU elements were changed without prior approval of the Technical Delegate this is not in accordance with Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. The competitor is therefore required to start the race from the pit lane per article 40.9 c) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 11 Changes Made During Parc Ferme
